svg.title: Four Buckets Across a $5,000–$30,000 Launch
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-07-startup-capital-allocation; chart type: stacked_comparison; title: Four Buckets Across a $5,000–$30,000 Launch; subtitle: Lean, working, and expanded launch budgets total $5,000, $15,000, and $30,000.; chapter number: 4; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: Numeric values show the $15,000 working-budget allocation. Each stage also states lean and expanded amounts for comparison. These are startup allocations, not annual operating expenses or canonical revenue scenarios; no bucket finances customer subscription principal.; caption: The working allocation is $4,500 + $3,000 + $4,500 + $3,000 = $15,000. Monthly opex remains the supplied $1,500–$9,500 planning range. Protect runway through the 1–3 month first-deal window without using customer-designated funds for brokerage expenses.; stages: label: Partner and contract setup; value: Lean $1,500; working $4,500; expanded $9,000; numeric value: 4500.0; detail: Allocate 30% to agreement review, customer mandates, bookkeeping setup, partner onboarding work, and insurance setup. Vendor-specific deposits require separate verification.; label: Systems and reconciliation; value: Lean $1,000; working $3,000; expanded $6,000; numeric value: 3000.0; detail: Allocate 20% to CRM configuration, access-controlled document storage, statement imports, renewal tracking, and audit-ready reconciliation templates before purchasing custom integrations.; label: Evidence-led acquisition; value: Lean $1,500; working $4,500; expanded $9,000; numeric value: 4500.0; detail: Allocate 30% to vertical prospect research, buyer interviews, permissioned outreach, and initial contract audits. Measure qualified opportunities rather than purchased contact volume.; label: Brokerage liquidity reserve; value: Lean $1,000; working $3,000; expanded $6,000; numeric value: 3000.0; detail: Allocate 20% to brokerage timing gaps and operating contingencies. Keep this reserve distinct from customer prefunding and increase runway if sales or settlement takes longer.

rect.title: label: Partner and contract setup; numeric value: 4500.0; value: Lean $1,500; working $4,500; expanded $9,000; detail: Allocate 30% to agreement review, customer mandates, bookkeeping setup, partner onboarding work, and insurance setup. Vendor-specific deposits require separate verification.
